started: The check started; its progress shows here and in the sidebar.
unavailable: Cannot be asked now: {names}. Enter the assistant's API key or a DataForSEO key, or connect your account to use credits.
byEngineHint: The latest answer of every question on every assistant
oneRun: The chart is drawn after the second check.
shareHint: The brands the answers name and the sources they cite
brandLine: Named in {mentions} answers, site cited in {citations}; average place {position}
noOwnPages: The answers do not cite pages of {domain} yet.
promptsHint: The latest answer of every question on every assistant; press a cell to read the whole answer
noAnswersText: Choose the assistants and press "Ask now"; every question is asked once on every chosen assistant.
shareOfVoiceHint: Your share of every brand mention
averagePositionHint: Among the brands an answer names
toneHint: Tone of the sentences naming your brand (lexicon based)
emptyText: Add the questions your customers might ask AI assistants; it measures whether {domain} is named in the answers, whether its site is cited, and its share against rivals.
addHint: At most 500 characters; at most 200 questions per project.
addPlaceholder:
What are the best running shoe brands?
Where can I buy trail running shoes?
suggestionsHint: From your brand and the keywords you track; press one to add it.
firstSchedule: How often should they be asked?
firstScheduleHint: Every check asks each question on every chosen assistant and is paid (your own keys, DataForSEO or OctopusOn credits). Choose manual to pay only when you ask.
ownBrandHint: The answers are searched for these names and your domain. Change the brand names in the project's settings.
rivalsHint: Their domain and the names answers may use (comma separated). When empty, the project's competitors are used; at most 10.
modelsHint: When empty, the default shown is used. With your own key, write the provider's model name; through DataForSEO, its model name.
noAnswer: This question has not been asked on this assistant yet.
mentionsHint: AI answers in DataForSEO's database that mention your domain (Google AI Overview and ChatGPT)
mentionsCount: Answers naming or citing your domain
aiVolumeHint: Estimated monthly volume of these questions in AI search
